As a Payroll & Benefits Administrator in Liverpool, you will manage payroll and benefits administration within the Transport & Distribution industry, helping the finance function run smoothly. You will keep employee pay and benefit records accurate, ensuring day-to-day administration is completed on time.

Client Details

The organisation operates in the Transport & Distribution industry in Liverpool.

Description
- Process payroll information accurately and within agreed deadlines.
- Maintain employee payroll records, ensuring changes are recorded clearly.
- Administer employee benefits and update related information when required.
- Respond to payroll and benefits queries with clear, helpful information.
- Check payroll data before submission to reduce errors and support accurate payments.
- Work closely with the Accounting & Finance department to resolve payroll-related issues.
- Keep payroll and benefits documentation organised and up to date.

Profile

A successful 'Payroll & Benefits Administrator' should have:
- Experience of payroll administration and maintaining accurate payroll records.
- Knowledge of employee benefits administration.
- Confidence handling payroll data with care and attention to detail.
- Ability to investigate and resolve routine payroll queries.
- Good organisational skills to manage deadlines and changing information.
- Clear communication skills when dealing with colleagues and employee queries.

title: Payroll Admin
description:
The Role

This is a focused, hands-on payroll processing role sitting within an established finance and payroll team, reporting directly into our Payroll Manager. You will act as a key independent operator in managing end-to-end processing for 100 client payrolls, totaling approximately 1,500 payslips. We are looking for an experienced professional to handle these operations independently, with initial support from the manager, offering a fantastic opportunity that can convert into a permanent position.

What We Offer
- Working Style: Part-time hours (around 20 to 30 hours per week) with a flexible hybrid model requiring just one day per week in our Liverpool City Centre office (reducing further once you are fully settled and comfortable in the role)
- Career Progression: Genuine opportunity to convert from a temporary contract into a permanent role
- Process: Efficient recruitment process consisting of a single Microsoft Teams interview

Key Responsibilities
- Manage and execute end-to-end payroll processing for a portfolio of 100 clients, handling roughly 1,500 payslips.
- Work autonomously to ensure accurate and timely payroll delivery, collaborating with and reporting directly to the Payroll Manager.
- Complete data entry, statutory calculations, and compliance checks for all client payroll runs.
- Efficiently resolve payroll-related queries from clients and internal stakeholders.

About You
- Experience: Proven background in independent, end-to-end payroll processing, ideally within a bureau or multi-client environment.
- Systems: Must be fully familiar with BrightPay payroll software, while additional experience with Xero Payroll is highly desirable.
- Attributes: A self-starter capable of managing workload independently while maintaining high accuracy and attention to detail.

title: Sales Ledger
description:
Temporary Sales Ledger / Credit Controller (Part-Time)

Liverpool (Office Based)

£14.00 - £19.00 per Hour

21 Hours Per Week

Immediate Start Available

A Liverpool-based organisation is looking to appoint an experienced Sales Ledger / Credit Controller to support its finance team on a part-time temporary basis.

This opportunity would suit an experienced finance professional who can quickly settle into a new environment and take ownership of day-to-day sales ledger responsibilities with minimal training. The role will involve working within a busy finance function, ensuring invoices are raised accurately, payments are allocated correctly and customer accounts remain up to date.

Whilst there is a credit control aspect to the position, it is not a traditional debt-chasing role. A significant part of the role will involve investigating outstanding balances, resolving invoice queries and identifying reasons why payments may not have been received.

Key Responsibilities
- Raising and processing customer invoices
- Allocating incoming payments
- Maintaining accurate sales ledger records
- Reconciling customer accounts
- Investigating outstanding balances and payment queries
- Liaising with customers and stakeholders regarding invoices and payments
- Supporting credit control activities where required
- Resolving account discrepancies
- Assisting with general transactional finance duties
- Supporting the wider finance team as required

Person Specification
- Previous experience within a Sales Ledger and/or Credit Control role
- Able to hit the ground running with minimal supervision
- Strong experience of invoicing, payment allocation and reconciliations
- Confident managing customer accounts and resolving queries
- Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills
- Strong communication skills
- Comfortable working within a busy office environment
- Experience using Xero would be advantageous but is not essential
- Available to start at short notice

Additional Information
- 21 hours per week
- Flexible working hours
- Fully office-based in Liverpool
- Temporary assignment with duration dependent on business requirements
- Immediate start available
- Hourly rate of £14.00 - £19.00 per hour, depending on experience

If you are an experienced Sales Ledger or Credit Control professional looking for a flexible part-time position where you can make an immediate impact, we would love to hear from you.

Please Note

This role requires a candidate who can hit the ground running from day one. As such, applications will only be considered from individuals with previous Sales Ledger, Credit Control or wider Finance experience. Please do not apply if you do not have relevant finance experience.
